decisions.reason: The metro data centre network rests on sunk owned-fibre investment, had publicly reported adoption, and is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, so the firm stays committed despite no recent website visibility.
Optical spectrum services exploit the costly fibre backbone, were showcased on a dedicated page, and fit the high-bandwidth strategy, so any weak visibility is read as temporary.
The number ordering portal is a low-cost software platform that supports the announced real-time provisioning direction, so keeping it is easy to justify.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service with little strategic centrality, but its low running cost, regulatory ties and existing customer base let management keep it a while longer.
Direct voice network connection builds on the established voice infrastructure and serves enterprise customers moving to cloud voice, so the firm persists with it.
